We need to find a template that does retrosynthesis of amide formation from carboxylic acid + amine (coupling). The target molecule is given: Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1

We need to find a template that when applied to this molecule reproduces the reaction: carboxylic acid to amide, breaking aliphatic carboxylic acid (C=O O-H) and forming C-N bond.

We need to search template catalog by criteria: functional_groups_broken: aliphatic carboxylic acid, functional_groups_formed: amide? Actually forward reaction: carboxylic acid + amine -> amide, so broken: aliphatic carboxylic acid (the acid group is broken), formed: amide (C-N). So we set functional_groups_broken = "aliphatic carboxylic acid", functional_groups_formed = "amide". Use search_template_catalog_by_criteria.
